title: Blur
description: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your next turn.
smart_description: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your next {Amount:plural:turn|{} turns}.
notes: Blur prevents block from being cleared at the end of the turn. Each turn, the stack decreases by 1. The power flashes when it prevents a block clear.
